title: November News
summary: Fireworks night round up, Christmas Fayre planning, Christmas jumpers and event lead opportunities.

sections.title: Dear Parents, Carers and Teachers,
paragraphs: We hope you all had a lovely half term and have settled into the second half of term.
Some highlights below: Fireworks night round up, Christmas Fayre planning and Event Lead opportunities for later this academic year 👀

sections.title: 🎆 Fireworks on the Field
paragraphs: What a night! 1500+ people filled the Ashley School field for an evening of fireworks, food and family fun.

A huge thank you to Helen Platt, who has organised the Ashley fireworks over the last few years. This was her final display, and what a send-off it was. Thank you also to the many parent, carer and teacher volunteers who ran the entrance, tokens, prize table, bar and stalls, and to Martin Flashman and Co for sponsoring the evening once again.
You can see all the school’s spend requests for the FOA here: [school spend requests](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/fundraising/).

sections.title: 🎄 Christmas Fayre: Saturday 5th December, 12pm - 3pm
paragraphs: Mark your calendars! On Saturday 5th December (12 - 3pm), we invite you to step through the wardrobe into the magical realm of **Narnia** for this year’s Ashley School Christmas Fayre!
Expect a truly magical afternoon packed with fun zone games, craft workshops, glitter tattoos, a photo booth and a Narnia trail around school grounds, as well as festive food and drink.
Our stall leads are busy prepping the games, materials and decorations - now we need our wonderful school community to help run them on the day!
Please sign up to help at the following link: [Christmas Fayre volunteering](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/christmas-fayre-volunteering/)
**Donations Day** - Friday 20th November: We will be hosting a Christmas Fayre Donations Day where classes will be assigned items to donate for prizes and the teacher's gift room.
**Reception & KS1:** Drinks Tombola - bottles (alcohol or non-alcoholic); Children's Toy Tombola - small cuddly toys/games/toys, max value £5.
**KS2:** Teacher's 'Socks & Chocs' Gift Room - adult sized, new, socks for men & women; new, sealed, chocolate boxes or boxed biscuits.
**Raffle prizes:** We are on the lookout for more raffle prizes - if your business or employer could donate something suitable, please let your class rep know.

**Props to loan**: Please have a look at the Props & Decor to Loan section on our sign-up page - we're looking to borrow fairy lights, undecorated artificial trees and easels to help bring the Narnia theme to life!
Entry is £2 and children under 12 go free - tickets on the door. Details: [www.thefriendsofashley.org/events/christmas-fayre-2026/](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/events/christmas-fayre-2026/)
Thank you to Rachel Briscoe (Squirrel and Otter) and Sophie Glass (Fox), who have been very busy conjuring up a truly magical afternoon for us all.

sections.title: 🎨 Christmas Fayre Art Competition
paragraphs: Calling all young artists! The theme of this year’s Christmas Fayre Art Competition is Narnia - show us your lions, witches and snow queens. Winter wonderland and Christmas themes are also welcome, and any medium goes: painting, drawing, crafts, knitting, sculpture and more.

One entry per child - A4 is ideal for the Fayre Gallery display, but anything is accepted. Hand entries in by Monday 30th November: pop them in the box in the Hall (on the windowsill near the doors) or leave them with the school office. Every entry will be on display at the Fayre, Steph Cotela is judging, and there will be something arty for prizes.
Full details: [www.thefriendsofashley.org/christmas-fayre-art-competition/](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/christmas-fayre-art-competition/)
Thanks to Steph Cotela, who is organising the competition for the 10th year.

sections.title: 👕 Pre-loved Uniform: Friday 4th December - Christmas Jumpers Needed!
paragraphs: Our last sale of the term is on Friday 4th December at 3:25pm in the school playground, subject to weather. Coats and new-logo items are £3, with all other items £1. Card payments only, please.
As the last sale before Christmas, we will be selling Christmas Jumpers - please donate any you have which are in GOOD condition!
All details on the FOA website Preloved page [Pre-loved uniform](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/uniform/)

sections.title: 📱 The FOA, wherever you are
paragraphs: Forgotten an event date or looking for a volunteer link? Our website brings together what's on, tickets, volunteering, pre-loved uniform, newsletters and fundraising updates. Please bookmark it for the next time you need a quick answer: [www.thefriendsofashley.org](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org).
We are also back on Instagram! Follow [@thefriendsofashley](https://www.instagram.com/thefriendsofashley/) for news, event countdowns and photos from our events.

sections.title: 🌟 Looking ahead: could you lead the Summer Fete or Big Picnic?
paragraphs: It may feel early, but two of our favourite events of the school year are looking for new leads.

The Summer Fete and the Big Picnic only happen thanks to parents and carers who step forward, and you would have the full support of the committee and a handover from previous organisers, with zero pressure.
If you are curious about leading either event, email [thefriendsofashley@gmail.com](mailto:thefriendsofashley@gmail.com) or grab us at the gates for a chat.
